image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Dean of Accreditation Prof. Dr. V. Vishnu Priya Dr. V. Vishnu Priya joined the Department of Biochemistry at Saveetha Institution in 2001 and has over 25 years of academic and research experience. She earned her Ph.D. from Saveetha University for her work on the anticancer efficacy of Garcinia mangostana pericarp extract. A Fellow of the International Medical Sciences Academy, she received advanced training in regenerative medicine at the University of Toronto and earned international fellowships from OIST, Japan, and IFCC, Brazil. She has been honoured with the Saveetha Ratna Award (2016), multiple Best Faculty Awards, the Young Achiever Award (2012), and the Prof. Kameswara Rao Award. She has presented globally, and her lab focuses on cancer biology, herbal medicine, and medical education.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Dean of International Affairs Prof. Dr. Sindhu Ramesh Dr. Sindhu Ramesh joined Saveetha in 2000 as a Senior Lecturer after completing her postgraduate training in 1999. She played a key role in introducing new undergraduate subjects—Dental Armamentarium and Aesthetic Dentistry—and launched the MSc Biomaterials program. Appointed Chair of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics in 2011, she led the establishment of India’s pioneering Comprehensive Clinic system and later served as Associate Dean of Clinics. As Associate Dean of Research, she received the National Best Researcher Award from the Minister of Education in 2018. She then served as Dean of Accreditation and Ranking (2018–2024). Recipient of the Best Dental Educator Award (IAE & British Dental Awards), she has numerous publications, research projects in nanomaterials and endodontics.

image:image.image:title: About us - Make it stand out
image:image.image:caption: Dean of Sustainability Prof. Dr. Dhanraj Ganapathy Dr. Dhanraj Ganapathy, Professor and Head of Prosthodontics, is distinguished for his expertise in research methodology, fixed and implant prosthodontics, and full-mouth rehabilitation, with over 150 publications and numerous academic and clinical awards. Beyond his clinical excellence, he is deeply committed to integrating sustainability into dental practice and education. He actively promotes material efficiency, the use of long-lasting biocompatible restorations, and digital workflows that reduce clinical waste and carbon footprint. His initiatives focus on energy-efficient clinic operations, responsible procurement, and incorporating environmental considerations into research training. Through his guidance, students and clinicians adopt eco-conscious approaches, reflecting his belief that ethical patient care must also minimise environmental impact and support long-term planetary health.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr.J.Kumutha, Dean Saveetha Medical College and Hospitals Dr. J. Kumutha, an esteemed Madras Medical College graduate, has excelled in pediatric healthcare for decades. She also advises on Child Health for the National Health Mission in Tamil Nadu. With a background as a former Head of Neonatology and Professor at the Institute of Child Health in Chennai. Dr. Kumutha has been pivotal in enhancing newborn care, notably in establishing NICUs statewide. Her academic involvement spans over 30 years, with notable contributions to medical literature and national guidelines. Recognized with prestigious awards, she is committed to advancing child health through training programs and professional leadership roles. Dr. Kumutha's dedication has profoundly impacted pediatric healthcare in Tamil Nadu and beyond, with over 20 publications in indexed journals and significant contributions to book chapters and national guidelines.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. S. Aravind Kumar, Dean Saveetha Dental College and Hospitals Dr Aravind Kumar graduated with his Bachelor’s and Master’s from Saveetha Dental College in 2000 and 2004 respectively. After graduation he chose to serve at his alma mater and joined as a senior lecturer in 2005. Having obtained his M.Ortho degree from Royal colleges of Surgeons - Edinburgh & Glasgow, he was very instrumental in making Saveetha Dental College as a centre for the M.Ortho exams, Glasgow. Dr Aravind has more than fifteen years of experience in the field of teaching and is a favourite amongst the students. He has been awarded the best dental educator award from the UK. He is also an active researcher and has been guiding post graduate and postdoctoral thesis. He has more than 100 publications in various indexed journals to his credit.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. B. Ramesh, Principal SIMATS Engineering Dr. Ramesh, received his Bachelor of Engineering from Karnatak University and Master of Engineering (Engineering Mechanics) from IIT Madras. Professor Ramesh received his doctoral degree from IIT, Roorkee. He has a total experience of 19 years in teaching, research and industry in various capacities and is being instrumental in driving the institute to deliver quality-packed education to the students. A few awards he has won are National Doctorate Fellowship for Ph.D., and the best lecturer award from SMIT. He is responsible / member for Academic Council, Board of Research, Educational Technical Unit and IRB (Institute Review Board). To his credit, he has 16 peer-reviewed journals published in National and International Journals. His areas of interest include sedimentation studies, structural dynamics and mechanics of structures. He teaches subjects like Structural Engineering, Design of Reinforced Concrete and Structural Analysis to all undergraduate and postgraduate students. This exuberant knowledge makes him a stalwart. His guidance to students is priceless.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. Asha Sundaram, Principal Saveetha School of Law After obtaining her B.A. LL. B (Hons) from School of Indian Legal Thought, Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala she did her LL.M. from School of Legal Studies, Cochin University of Science and Technology with a specialization in Criminal Law, Constitutional law and Jurisprudence. She cleared the National Eligibility Test for Lectureship (NET) conducted by UGC in 2001.She did her doctoral studies at the JJT University, Rajasthan in Health Care Law titled ‘Legal and ethical issues on medical research involving human beings in India’. She has taught law at the School of Legal Studies, Kannur University, School of Legal Studies of Cochin University of Science and Technology, School of Indian Legal Thought, M.G University, Parvin Gandhi College of Law, SVKM, Mumbai, School of law Rights and Constitutional Governance, TISS, Mumbai, School of Legal Studies Central University of Kerala and in SNGCLS Kollam before Joining Saveetha School of Law. She has practised at the High Court of Kerala. She has organised several National and International Conferences , Seminars and Workshops. She has presented papers at National and International Conferences and also published articles in reputed journals. She is a member of the Global Alliance for Justice Education.( GALE). World Commission on Environmental Law ( WCEL) . Her areas of interest include Health care laws, Environmental Law , Criminal Law and Constitutional Law.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. R. Durai Pandian, Principal Saveetha School of Management Dr. R. Durai Pandian is an accomplished academic and visionary leader, currently serving as the Principal of Saveetha School of Management (SSM), Saveetha University, Chennai. With over 26 years of teaching and research experience and 7 years of managerial expertise in the Hospitality Services, he exemplifies a unique blend of academic rigor and professional excellence. Dr. Pandian’s academic qualifications include a Ph.D. from Alagappa Institute of Management, Alagappa University, where he was the first full-time doctoral graduate of the institute, and an MBA from Manipal University. His pursuit of excellence is evident in his completion of prestigious Faculty Development Programmes (FDPM) at IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Kozhikode, and IIM Indore, alongside a one-month Research Fellowship Program at the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDII), Ahmedabad. Additionally, his leadership skills are reflected in his NCC “C” Certificate (1993 batch). A recipient of multiple awards and accolades, Dr. Pandian’s dedication to education is complemented by his personal interests in historical exploration and sustainable agriculture. His passion for organic farming highlights his commitment to fostering holistic and sustainable development.

image:image.image:title: About us
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. N. Jothilakshmy, Principal Saveetha College of Architecture & Design Professor Dr. N. Jothilakshmy is a dedicated and accomplished researcher specializing in urban design. She is deeply committed to nurturing research skills among aspiring architects, drawing from her extensive experience in architectural research. Her academic journey began with a Bachelor's degree from the College of Engineering Trivandrum in 1991. Subsequently, she pursued a Master's degree in Town and Country Planning from Anna University in 2000. Her doctoral research, conducted at the School of Architecture & Planning at Anna University, focused on the topic of "Evaluation of Form-Based Codes and the Image of Chennai, Tamil Nadu." In 2020, Dr. Jothilakshmy was appointed as the Senior Architect Consultant by the Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA) under the AMRUTH Project. Her role involves contributing to the Local Area Plan (LAP) development for George Town, Chennai, including the formulation of Form-Based Codes and the Town Planning Scheme (TPS) for Madambakkom, Chennai. She coordinated and achieved Guinness Records for the longest painting in 2002 and the largest eggshell art mural in 2016. image:image.image:caption: Dr. N.M. Veeraiyan, Chancellor Dr. N. M. Veeraiyan, Chancellor of SIMATS, is a distinguished FELLOW of the Pierre Fauchard Academy and an accomplished Tamil scholar, celebrated for co-authoring the award-winning Vaai Pal Maruthuvam, recognised by the Government of Tamil Nadu. A visionary leader in healthcare and higher education, he has received numerous honours, including the Lifetime Achievement Award from The T.N. Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, the Edupreneur Award from the Times of India, the Inspiration Leaders of India Award, and the Award of Excellence from the Indian Red Cross Society. Renowned for his integrity, discipline, and unwavering dedication to public welfare, he has transformed Saveetha into a nationally admired institution. Staff and students look up to him as a guiding force whose vision continues to inspire progress and excellence.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Dr. Deepak Nallaswamy Veeraiyan. MDS, MS (U.Toronto), MDP (Harvard), Ph.D. Pro - Chancellor SIMATS Dr. Deepak Nallaswamy Veeraiyan, MDS, MS (University of Toronto), MDP (Harvard), is a clinician, academic leader, and institutional strategist known for shaping the growth of SIMATS into a nationally distinguished university. With a strong international academic foundation, he integrates evidence-based dentistry, technology, large-scale healthcare delivery, and modern educational systems. His leadership spans curriculum reform, research development, global collaborations, and major infrastructure projects that strengthen clinical capacity and student outcomes. Widely regarded for his disciplined execution and forward-thinking approach, he continues to drive transformative initiatives that elevate quality, innovation, and societal impact across higher education and healthcare in India.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Dr. Ramya Deepak., M.Tech, PhD Mrs. Ramya Deepak, Director of SIMATS, is a dynamic leader known for combining clarity, discipline, and compassionate administration in steering the university’s academic and operational growth. With a strong commitment to student welfare, quality systems, and institutional excellence, she plays a pivotal role in strengthening academic processes, infrastructure development, and collaborative initiatives across all constituent colleges. Her leadership style balances high expectations with empathy, ensuring that every project is executed with precision and purpose. She is widely admired for her organisational acumen, inclusive approach, and unwavering dedication to elevating SIMATS to national and global prominence. Students, faculty, and staff regard her as a steady, inspiring presence who consistently drives progress, professionalism, and innovation across the university.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Dean of Accreditation Prof. Dr. V. Vishnu Priya Dr. V. Vishnu Priya joined the Department of Biochemistry at Saveetha Dental College in 2001 and has over 21 years of academic and research experience. She earned her Ph.D. from Saveetha University for her work on the anticancer efficacy of Garcinia mangostana pericarp extract. A Fellow of the International Medical Sciences Academy, she received advanced training in regenerative medicine at the University of Toronto and earned international fellowships from OIST, Japan, and IFCC, Brazil. She has been honoured with the Saveetha Ratna Award (2016), multiple Best Faculty Awards, the Young Achiever Award (2012), and the Prof. Kameswara Rao Award. She has presented globally, and her lab focuses on cancer biology, herbal medicine, and medical education.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Dean of International Affairs Prof. Dr. Sindhu Ramesh Dr. Sindhu Ramesh joined Saveetha in 2000 as a Senior Lecturer after completing her postgraduate training in 1999. She played a key role in introducing new undergraduate subjects—Dental Armamentarium and Aesthetic Dentistry—and launched the MSc Biomaterials program. Appointed Chair of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics in 2011, she led the establishment of India’s pioneering Comprehensive Clinic system and later served as Associate Dean of Clinics. As Associate Dean of Research, she received the National Best Researcher Award from the Minister of Education in 2018. She then served as Dean of Accreditation and Ranking (2018–2024). Recipient of the Best Dental Educator Award (IAE & British Dental Awards), she has numerous publications, research projects in nanomaterials and endodontics.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy) - Make it stand out
image:image.image:caption: Dean of Sustainability Prof. Dr. Dhanraj Ganapathy Dr. Dhanraj Ganapathy, Professor and Head of Prosthodontics, is distinguished for his expertise in research methodology, fixed and implant prosthodontics, and full-mouth rehabilitation, with over 150 publications and numerous academic and clinical awards. Beyond his clinical excellence, he is deeply committed to integrating sustainability into dental practice and education. He actively promotes material efficiency, the use of long-lasting biocompatible restorations, and digital workflows that reduce clinical waste and carbon footprint. His initiatives focus on energy-efficient clinic operations, responsible procurement, and incorporating environmental considerations into research training. Through his guidance, students and clinicians adopt eco-conscious approaches, reflecting his belief that ethical patient care must also minimise environmental impact and support long-term planetary health.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr.J.Kumutha, Dean Saveetha Medical College and Hospitals Dr. J. Kumutha, an esteemed Madras Medical College graduate, has excelled in pediatric healthcare for decades. She also advises on Child Health for the National Health Mission in Tamil Nadu. With a background as a former Head of Neonatology and Professor at the Institute of Child Health in Chennai. Dr. Kumutha has been pivotal in enhancing newborn care, notably in establishing NICUs statewide. Her academic involvement spans over 30 years, with notable contributions to medical literature and national guidelines. Recognized with prestigious awards, she is committed to advancing child health through training programs and professional leadership roles. Dr. Kumutha's dedication has profoundly impacted pediatric healthcare in Tamil Nadu and beyond, with over 20 publications in indexed journals and significant contributions to book chapters and national guidelines.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. S. Aravind Kumar, Dean Saveetha Dental College and Hospitals Dr Aravind Kumar graduated with his Bachelor’s and Master’s from Saveetha Dental College in 2000 and 2004 respectively. After graduation he chose to serve at his alma mater and joined as a senior lecturer in 2005. Having obtained his M.Ortho degree from Royal colleges of Surgeons - Edinburgh & Glasgow, he was very instrumental in making Saveetha Dental College as a centre for the M.Ortho exams, Glasgow. Dr Aravind has more than fifteen years of experience in the field of teaching and is a favourite amongst the students. He has been awarded the best dental educator award from the UK. He is also an active researcher and has been guiding post graduate and postdoctoral thesis. He has more than 100 publications in various indexed journals to his credit.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. B. Ramesh, Principal SIMATS Engineering Dr. Ramesh, received his Bachelor of Engineering from Karnatak University and Master of Engineering (Engineering Mechanics) from IIT Madras. Professor Ramesh received his doctoral degree from IIT, Roorkee. He has a total experience of 19 years in teaching, research and industry in various capacities and is being instrumental in driving the institute to deliver quality-packed education to the students. A few awards he has won are National Doctorate Fellowship for Ph.D., and the best lecturer award from SMIT. He is responsible / member for Academic Council, Board of Research, Educational Technical Unit and IRB (Institute Review Board). To his credit, he has 16 peer-reviewed journals published in National and International Journals. His areas of interest include sedimentation studies, structural dynamics and mechanics of structures. He teaches subjects like Structural Engineering, Design of Reinforced Concrete and Structural Analysis to all undergraduate and postgraduate students. This exuberant knowledge makes him a stalwart. His guidance to students is priceless.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. Asha Sundaram, Principal Saveetha School of Law After obtaining her B.A. LL. B (Hons) from School of Indian Legal Thought, Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala she did her LL.M. from School of Legal Studies, Cochin University of Science and Technology with a specialization in Criminal Law, Constitutional law and Jurisprudence. She cleared the National Eligibility Test for Lectureship (NET) conducted by UGC in 2001.She did her doctoral studies at the JJT University, Rajasthan in Health Care Law titled ‘Legal and ethical issues on medical research involving human beings in India’. She has taught law at the School of Legal Studies, Kannur University, School of Legal Studies of Cochin University of Science and Technology, School of Indian Legal Thought, M.G University, Parvin Gandhi College of Law, SVKM, Mumbai, School of law Rights and Constitutional Governance, TISS, Mumbai, School of Legal Studies Central University of Kerala and in SNGCLS Kollam before Joining Saveetha School of Law. She has practised at the High Court of Kerala. She has organised several National and International Conferences , Seminars and Workshops. She has presented papers at National and International Conferences and also published articles in reputed journals. She is a member of the Global Alliance for Justice Education.( GALE). World Commission on Environmental Law ( WCEL) . Her areas of interest include Health care laws, Environmental Law , Criminal Law and Constitutional Law.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. R. Durai Pandian, Principal Saveetha School of Management Dr. R. Durai Pandian is an accomplished academic and visionary leader, currently serving as the Principal of Saveetha School of Management (SSM), Saveetha University, Chennai. With over 26 years of teaching and research experience and 7 years of managerial expertise in the Hospitality Services, he exemplifies a unique blend of academic rigor and professional excellence. Dr. Pandian’s academic qualifications include a Ph.D. from Alagappa Institute of Management, Alagappa University, where he was the first full-time doctoral graduate of the institute, and an MBA from Manipal University. His pursuit of excellence is evident in his completion of prestigious Faculty Development Programmes (FDPM) at IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Kozhikode, and IIM Indore, alongside a one-month Research Fellowship Program at the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDII), Ahmedabad. Additionally, his leadership skills are reflected in his NCC “C” Certificate (1993 batch). A recipient of multiple awards and accolades, Dr. Pandian’s dedication to education is complemented by his personal interests in historical exploration and sustainable agriculture. His passion for organic farming highlights his commitment to fostering holistic and sustainable development.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. N. Jothilakshmy, Principal Saveetha College of Architecture & Design Professor Dr. N. Jothilakshmy is a dedicated and accomplished researcher specializing in urban design. She is deeply committed to nurturing research skills among aspiring architects, drawing from her extensive experience in architectural research. Her academic journey began with a Bachelor's degree from the College of Engineering Trivandrum in 1991. Subsequently, she pursued a Master's degree in Town and Country Planning from Anna University in 2000. Her doctoral research, conducted at the School of Architecture & Planning at Anna University, focused on the topic of "Evaluation of Form-Based Codes and the Image of Chennai, Tamil Nadu." In 2020, Dr. Jothilakshmy was appointed as the Senior Architect Consultant by the Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA) under the AMRUTH Project. Her role involves contributing to the Local Area Plan (LAP) development for George Town, Chennai, including the formulation of Form-Based Codes and the Town Planning Scheme (TPS) for Madambakkom, Chennai. She coordinated and achieved Guinness Records for the longest painting in 2002 and the largest eggshell art mural in 2016. Her contributions also extended to creating the Limca Book of Records for the longest maze with recycled materials in 2013 and the largest backdrop with recycled bottle caps in 2015.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. Gunita Arun Chandhok, Principal Saveetha College of Liberal Arts & Sciences Dr. Gunita Arun Chandhok, a distinguished academician in Commerce and an administrator with 24 years of experience in the field of education. She has served in various capacities including Head of the Department of Commerce, Director and Vice Principal at self financing educational institutions in Chennai. She has various national and international paper presentations and publications to her credit. Dr. Gunita has been a panel member of FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry), TN higher education council and Honorary Chair person of the Chennai International Youth festival. She is a member of National Foundation for Entrepreneurship development, Coimbatore and Indian Science Congress. In recognition of her contribution in the field of higher education, she has received several awards in the last decade. She was Conferred the “All India Best Academic Administrator Award - 2015” by Dr. A. Kalanithi, former Vice-Chancellor, Anna University, “Distinguished Educator and Scholar Award - 2016” by National Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development, Coimbatore, “Award for Educational Leadership” from Shri. Sunil Paliwal IAS, Principal Secretary , Dept. of Higher Education, Govt. of TN, organized by Indus Foundation, USA in 2017 and the “Excellence in Education Award” from Dr. Montek Singh Ahluwalia, Former Deputy Chairman, Planning Commission, New Delhi in 2019.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. R. Vijayalakshmi, Principal Saveetha College of Nursing Dr. R. Vijayalakshmi is a dedicated educator and respected leader in the nursing field, celebrated for her unwavering passion for teaching, clinical care, and research. She earned her Ph.D. in Nursing from T.N. Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, complemented by a Master of Science in Nursing from Apollo College of Nursing and a Bachelor of Science in Nursing from M.A. Chidambaram College of Nursing. Her academic pursuits also include specialized training in Operating Room Techniques and Management from Christian Medical College & Hospital in Vellore, as well as a Post Graduate Diploma in Values of Health Care from Annamalai University. Furthermore, she is certified in NABH Standards for Nursing Excellence by the Quality Council of India and has completed a certificate course in Essentials of Palliative Care from the Indian Association of Palliative Care. Dr. Vijayalakshmi has held significant roles in nursing education, including her tenure as the Principal of Tagore College of Nursing, The Cancer Institute in Adyar, and Sri Mahalakshmi Women’s College of Nursing. Her career began as an Assistant Lecturer at M.A. Chidambaram College of Nursing in Chennai, after which she became a Lecturer at KPJ International College of Nursing & Health Sciences in Nillai, Malaysia. At Omayal Achi College of Nursing, she progressed through various leadership positions, including Reader, Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, and Head of the OBG Department.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy) - Make it stand out
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. Ramaiyan Velmurugan, Principal Saveetha College of Pharmacy Dr. Ramaiyan Velmurugan holds a Ph.D. and M. Pharma with 17 years in academia and 5 years in research, Dr. Velmurugan specializes in Pharmacokinetics, Drug Metabolism, and Nano Drug Delivery. His educational journey includes a B. Pharmacy from The Tamilnadu Dr. M.G.R Medical University in 2002, M. Pharmacy (Pharmacology) from Annamalai University in 2006, and a Ph.D. in Pharmacology from Annamalai University in 2014. Dr. Velmurugan's significant achievements include being the Principal Investigator on a UGC-funded project on nanostructured lipid carriers for oral anticancer drug delivery. He has been granted patents for various compositions and methods related to drug delivery and therapeutic potential. His notable publications cover diverse topics, such as the synthesis of Quinoline-2-Carboxylic acid aryl ester and its apoptotic action on PC3 prostate cancer cell line. He has authored books and book chapters, including one on Paclitaxel and Spirulina nanoparticles for cancer therapy. Dr. Velmurugan has guided numerous Ph.D. and PG theses, demonstrating a commitment to mentorship. His expertise, research contributions, and academic leadership make him a distinguished figure in the field of pharmacy and pharmaceutical sciences.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr. Prathap Suganthirababu, Principal Saveetha College of Physiotherapy Dr. Prathap Suganthirababu Research Coordinator for Doctoral Studies at Saveetha College of Physiotherapy, Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences. With 21 years of teaching and research experience. His research interests include Neuro-Rehabilitation, Diabetic Neuropathy, LASER Therapy, Women's Health, Sports Fitness and Nutrition, and Medical Education. He has received numerous awards, including the Significant Achievement Award by the Indian Physiotherapists Welfare Association (2012), the Significant Contribution to Physiotherapy Profession by the Indian Association of Physiotherapists (2013), the Professional Excellence Award at the International Physiotherapy Conference (2017), and the Man of Visionary Award from the Rotary Club of Royapettah (2024).

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Prof. Dr.M.Arun Kumar, Principal Saveetha College of Occupational Therapy He had received his Bachelor of Occupational Therapy / Master of Occupational Therapy (BOT/MOT) from Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, currently pursuing a Ph.D. In the field of Rehabilitation sciences, He has 16 year of experience in Teaching, clinical and Research domain in Occupational Therapy, serving as Executive committee member in All India Occupational Therapist Association, presented many papers in National /International Seminars, workshop, conference related to Occupational Therapy, published papers in impact journals, and article related to occupational Therapy in various regional newspapers/magazine, constructed many workshop, Seminar, Hand on training programmes for professional development.

image:image.image:title: About us (Copy)
image:image.image:caption: Dr. Lavanya Prathap, Principal Saveetha College of Allied Health Sciences Dr. Lavanya Prathap, BPT, MBA (HM) MSc (Medical Anatomy), PhD Cert. Epigenetics in gene expression (Australia), Cert. Lifestyle medicine (USA), Cert. HPE (USA), CCLAS (FELASA).Dr. Lavanya Prathap, Professor (Anatomy) & Principal, SIMATS College of Allied Health Sciences, SIMATS Medical College, Chairperson of Institutional Animal Ethics Committee, (BRULAC) . She served as a teaching faculty in National and International Medical Universities for more than 16 years.
